verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Notion databases have pages with properties. Webhooks report 'property changes', and community users praise Notion's database functionality and describe it as 'incredibly flexible and configurable', sitting between strict JIRA/PM tools and unstructured wikis. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents creating custom fields or defining workflow statuses, so support is thin and inferred. Missing for 10: first-party docs on custom property/field types, configurable status options or workflow stages, and hands-on evidence of tailoring a tracker to a team process.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process
